meta.status: PROPOSAL - not yet reviewed by Nick
meta.purpose: Additional shampoo-only candidates to extend selection-batch1-draft.json's 8 pilot + 31 backlog shampoo entries toward a ~50-SKU shampoo research wave. Companion file: shampoo-wave-extension.md.
meta.method: dm.de shampoo search (sorted by Beliebtheit, paged past the first ~30 results already covered in selection-batch1-draft.json via repeated 'Mehr laden' loads) and rossmann.de Shampoo category (pages 1-2), cross-checked by hand against: (a) the existing-catalog brand/variant list supplied in the task brief, (b) selection-batch1-draft.json's own pilot (8) and backlog (31) shampoo entries.
meta.rank_continuation: Continues from the highest rank used in selection-batch1-draft.json (152) - new ranks start at 153.
meta.does_not_modify: selection-batch1-draft.json and selection-batch1-draft.md were read-only references for this pass; nothing in this file has been merged into them.

candidates.name: Shampoo Full Hair Magic
candidates.rationale: 1266 dm reviews - the single highest-reviewed new find in this pass. Gliss has no product under this name anywhere in the existing catalog or in selection-batch1-draft.json (which only covers Gliss Sealing Miracle, Liquid Silk, Total Repair); distinct volumizing sub-line.

candidates.name: Shampoo Bond Repair Anti-Haarschäden
candidates.rationale: 1131 dm reviews. Completes the Bond Repair line: the matching conditioner (rank 13) and leave-in serum (rank 118) are already in the selection-batch1-draft.json pilot, but the shampoo itself was missing from that pass.

candidates.name: Shampoo For Men
candidates.rationale: 838 dm reviews. schauma only has 'Anti Schuppen' in the existing catalog and 'Repair & Pflege' in the backlog (rank 33) - this men's-targeted variant is a distinct, high-volume SKU neither covers.

candidates.name: Shampoo Grow Abundant Anti-Haarverlust
candidates.rationale: 693 dm reviews. The matching conditioner is already in the backlog (rank 67, 'keep cosmetic framing, avoid medical hair-loss claims in copy') - this is the shampoo half of the same line, missing from that pass. Same framing caution applies: market as cosmetic thickening/fullness support, not a medical anti-hair-loss treatment.

candidates.name: Shampoo scalp balance Tiefenreinigung
candidates.rationale: 568 dm reviews. Scalp-focused deep-cleanse shampoo (cosmetic, not medical - same category precedent as the existing catalog's Balea Kopfhaut Sensitive shampoo); distinct sub-line from the three other Gliss shampoos already covered.

candidates.name: Shampoo Nutri-Coffein #langehaare
candidates.rationale: 450 dm reviews. Plantur 21 is a distinct Dr. Wolff sub-brand from 'Plantur 39 Coffein' already in the existing catalog (21 = long-hair/growth-support positioning vs. 39 = post-menopausal thinning) and from 'Dr. Wolff Plantur DMG Clinical' in the backlog (rank 54). Same cosmetic-framing caution as those two: caffeine/hair-growth marketing claims, keep language cosmetic not medical.

candidates.name: Shampoo Keratin Sleek
candidates.rationale: 444 dm reviews. Distinct Fructis sub-line from Locken Methode (pilot) and Coco Water (backlog rank 34); anti-frizz/keratin positioning not otherwise covered.

candidates.name: Shampoo Totes Meer
candidates.rationale: 405 rossmann reviews - highest-reviewed Isana find in this pass. Isana MED already has 'Jeden Tag (Ultra Sensitiv)' and 'pH 5,5 hautneutral' in the backlog (ranks 50-51); this Dead-Sea-minerals variant is a third, distinct Isana MED SKU. EAN not captured - Rossmann's listing cards did not expose a GTIN field in this pass (same limitation noted in selection-batch1-draft.md).

candidates.name: Shampoo Plex Care
candidates.rationale: 314 dm reviews. 'Balea PROFESSIONAL' is a distinct dm private-label sub-brand from plain 'Balea'/'Balea med' (which covers the existing catalog's 2in1 Urea/Aqua Hyaluron/Kopfhaut Sensitive/Ultimate Volume/Ultra Sensitive/Med Anti Schuppen variants) - none of those are Balea PROFESSIONAL SKUs. Weighted here per the brief's private-label priority; two sibling Balea PROFESSIONAL shampoos (Silberglanz, Wachstum + Stärke) were also seen on dm but not pursued further to keep this wave focused.

candidates.name: Shampoo Keratin & Repair
candidates.rationale: 195 rossmann reviews. Isana PROFESSIONAL only has an oil (rank 29) and a conditioner (rank 82/84/85) in selection-batch1-draft.json - this is the first Isana PROFESSIONAL shampoo in the ledger, private-label priority. EAN not captured (Rossmann listing limitation).

candidates.name: Plex Shampoo
candidates.rationale: 166 rossmann reviews. Second Isana PROFESSIONAL shampoo variant (bond/plex positioning, mirrors the Balea PROFESSIONAL Plex Care pick above at the other retailer's private label). EAN not captured.

candidates.name: Shampoo Energy Effect
candidates.rationale: 162 rossmann reviews. 'Isana MEN' is a men's-targeted Isana sub-brand not otherwise represented anywhere in the catalog or selection-batch1-draft.json (a sibling SKU, 'Fresh Power', 139 reviews, was also seen but not pursued to keep the wave focused). EAN not captured.

candidates.name: Shampoo Kokosmilch & Macadamia Normales & Trockenes Haar
candidates.rationale: 160 rossmann reviews. Wahre Schätze already appears twice in the existing catalog (Aktivkohle, Hafermilch) and once in the pilot (Honig Schätze); this Kokosmilch & Macadamia variant is a distinct third/fourth formulation, not a duplicate of any of those. A second Wahre Schätze variant ('Sanfte Tonerde & Zitrone', 86 reviews) was also seen but not pursued to keep the wave focused.

candidates.name: Sheer Blonde Refresh & Shine Shampoo
candidates.rationale: 94 rossmann reviews. selection-batch1-draft.json's backlog has the Sheer Blonde CONDITIONER (rank 77) and the Violet Crush Intensiv Silber SHAMPOO (rank 53), but not this Sheer Blonde shampoo - completes the pairing. EAN is derived from the numeric segment of the product-page URL (same pattern/confidence level the original draft used for 'Being Big Hair Shampoo'): passes EAN-13 checksum validation but was not read from an explicit GTIN field on the page (Rossmann did not expose one here), so treat as moderate-confidence/unverified, not a guess.

candidates.name: Shampoo Bouncy Curls
candidates.rationale: 88 dm reviews - lowest-reviewed pick in this wave, included for category completion rather than pure popularity: Aussie has a leave-in in the existing catalog and a conditioner in the backlog (rank 68, same 'Bouncy Curls' line) but no shampoo anywhere in the ledger yet.

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo Ultra Sensitive / Duschgel & Shampoo 5% Urea 2in1 / Shampoo Anti-Schuppen Ultra Sensitive / Shampoo Totes Meer Ultra Sensitive
considered_and_rejected.reason: near-duplicate of existing catalog 'Balea 2in1 Urea' and 'Balea ... Ultra Sensitive' / 'Balea Med Anti Schuppen' entries by name.

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo Glycolic Gloss, 200 ml (dm) / Glycolic Gloss Spiegelglanz Shampoo, 300 ml (rossmann)
considered_and_rejected.reason: already in the existing catalog under the truncated name 'Ultimate Shampoo' per selection-batch1-draft.md's Corrections section (GTIN 3600524128005 confirmed).

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo Limettenduft, Tiefenreinigung & Glanz
considered_and_rejected.reason: judgment call: name pattern strongly suggests this is the existing catalog's 'Herbal Essences Tiefenreinigung' entry, not a new formulation - excluded rather than risk a silent duplicate.

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo Blütensanft Rosenduft / Fiji / Dolce Vita / Feuchtigkeit Aloe Vera / Repair Arganöl
considered_and_rejected.reason: Blütensanft and Fiji are already selection-batch1-draft.json backlog ranks 32/35. Dolce Vita (294 rev), Feuchtigkeit Aloe Vera (115 rev) and Repair Arganöl (76 rev) are genuinely new and not duplicates, but were left out to keep this wave's per-brand spread reasonable given three other Herbal Essences shampoos are already in the ledger - good next candidates if Nick wants a second top-up wave.

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo Every-Day (400/200 ml) / Anti-Schuppen / Anti-Schuppen Plus
considered_and_rejected.reason: duplicate risk against existing catalog 'Sebamed 4x' - brief gives no variant names to disambiguate against, so treated as too risky rather than guessed.

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo Totes Meer Therapie Anti-Juckreiz / Anti-Schuppen Totes Meer
considered_and_rejected.reason: duplicate risk against existing catalog 'Salthouse 3x' - same reasoning as sebamed above.

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo Derma x Pro Beruhigende Pflege (250/400 ml) / Anti-Schuppen Citrus Fresh / Anti-Schuppen bei juckender Kopfhaut
considered_and_rejected.reason: Derma x Pro is the same product line Nick already parked as scalp_care in selection-batch1-draft.md's Corrections #2 (the matching Derma x Pro leave-in serum) - kept out of the shampoo/haircare wave for consistency. Citrus Fresh / juckende Kopfhaut carry duplicate risk against existing catalog 'Head&Shoulders 4x' and had low review counts (56/59).

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo ProGrowth + Peptide
considered_and_rejected.reason: duplicate risk against existing catalog 'OGX 4x' - no variant names given to disambiguate.

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo Frische & Leichtigkeit Anti Fett (cross-confirmed dm 273 / rossmann 36 reviews) / Silber Glanz & Pflege / Reparatur & Aufbau / Kraft + Fülle / Anti-Schuppen
considered_and_rejected.reason: duplicate risk against existing catalog 'Guhl 5x' - no variant names given to disambiguate; Frische & Leichtigkeit Anti Fett is the strongest of these (273 dm reviews, cross-confirmed) and worth a manual catalog check if Nick wants to free it up.

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo & Conditioner Express 2in1 (dm, 142 rev) / 2in1 Express Shampoo & Spülung (rossmann, 31 rev, same product)
Shampoo DMG Clinical
considered_and_rejected.reason: already in selection-batch1-draft.json backlog as 'Dr. Wolff Plantur DMG Clinical' (rank 54) - same product, dm listing just drops the 'Dr. Wolff' prefix.

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo Lovely Long (165 rev) / Hydrate & Shine (22 rev)
considered_and_rejected.reason: selection-batch1-draft.md's own conditioner notes (rank 69) name 'Lovely Long' as one of the two existing-catalog Langhaarmädchen variants ('Beautiful Curls + Lovely Long') - too high a duplicate risk to include without a category/product-type check. Hydrate & Shine had too few reviews (22) to be worth the same risk.

considered_and_rejected.name: Go Blonder Aufhellendes Shampoo
considered_and_rejected.reason: genuinely new (88 rossmann reviews, not a duplicate of anything in the ledger) but dropped in favor of the higher-reviewed Sheer Blonde pick to keep the John Frieda share of this wave to one item; good next candidate for a follow-up wave.

considered_and_rejected.name: Shampoo & Conditioner & Haarkur 3in1 Repair & Care / Shampoo Locken Pur
considered_and_rejected.reason: 3in1 format (271 rev) and Locken Pur (173 rev) are not obvious duplicates of anything named in the existing catalog's 'Pantene 5x' or elsewhere in the ledger, but were left out in favor of the stronger Grow Abundant pick to avoid over-weighting one brand and because 'Pantene 5x' already has unknown variant overlap risk.
